Student Research Forum

Content created for @srfaku
Reels · Event posters

SRF runs the International Student Research Conference (ISRC) — an annual academic conference with pre-conference workshops, guest speakers, and a journal club. My work here covers the promo reels and speaker/event posters that announce it.

Pre-Conference Workshops 2025

Promo reel announcing SRF's pre-conference hands-on workshops ahead of ISRC. Bold stacked text over live workshop footage to keep the announcement legible even muted, autoplay-first.

ISRC 2025 In-Person Journal Club

A four-speaker carousel announcing the Journal Club track of ISRC 2025 — one slide per speaker, each pairing their published research with talk title, room, and time. Built as a single reusable template so the whole set reads as one campaign.

Surgery Interest Group

Content created for @sig_aku
Instagram Stories

SIG's flagship event is the Surgical Olympiad. My work here is almost entirely Stories — shot, written, and posted myself — built to answer real audience questions and keep registration momentum going in the run-up to the deadline.

Story series4 slides · Q&A

Surgical Olympiad — Question Sticker Q&A

Used Instagram's question sticker to surface and answer the questions people were actually DMing about — eligibility, how to apply, and selection dates — each answer shot on location around campus.

Photographed and written by me

Story series4 slides · Trend format

"Kinda Chic To…" Skills Series

Adapted a trending story format to list the hands-on skills the Olympiad teaches — suturing, laparoscopic simulation, BLS — each on a rotating flat color with a cutout photo and hand-drawn pointer, closing on a direct sign-up CTA.

Photographed and written by me

Story series4 of 5 slides · Listicle

"5 Things You Need to Know (and 1 You Don't)"

A numbered listicle format building anticipation slide by slide, then subverting itself with a comedic twist reveal on the final slide. One slide from this set wasn't saved, but the format and payoff still come through.

Photographed and written by me

Featured individual's likeness and name used with their consent.

Story series4 slides · Character-driven

Character-Driven Reminder Series

A registration-deadline reminder is easy to scroll past, so I built it around a recurring character instead — a running gag through his day — landing on the actual reminder only once the audience is already invested in the bit.

Photographed and written by me

Featured individual's likeness and name used with their consent.

StorySingle slide · Final reminder

Final Reminder — Registrations Close Today

Last-call urgency copy and callback humor layered on top of an existing event poster for the final push before registrations closed.

Copy and layout by me — the underlying event poster was designed by someone else.

How I work

I handle content end to end for both societies: shooting photos and video on location, editing reels, designing posters, and writing the captions and story copy that go with them. Most of the work starts from a real event or a real question the audience is already asking — the format follows from that, not the other way around.
